source: Owner request 2026-11-20: GeminiNeon concepts (relative strength, opening range, 52-week high, NR7, VWAP, volume dry-up, gap-and-go). Liquidity floor on every entry.

strategies.name: GeminiNeon-Strongest Kid in Class
strategies.description: Relative strength: Nifty 50 down over the last week while the stock is up and closes above its 20-day high
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 20)[1] >= 150000000 and close[1] >= 50 and (bench(close / close[5] - 1) < 0 and close > close[5] and close > highest(high, 20)[1])

blocked.reason: Needs official Nifty 50 index history; owner rule: ETF prices must not substitute for index data.
blocked.proposed_data: register official NSE Nifty 50 history, or owner approves the NIFTYBEES proxy; then remove this block

strategies.name: GeminiNeon-Morning Box
strategies.description: Opening range breakout: a 15m candle closes above the first 30 minutes' high on above-average volume
strategies.entry: avg_day_volume(20) * prev_day_close() >= 150000000 and prev_day_close() >= 50 and (cross_above(close, or_high(30)) and volume > sma(volume, 20))

strategies.name: GeminiNeon-No-Ceiling
strategies.description: 52-week high: close above every close of the last 250 sessions on >= 1.5x average volume
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 20)[1] >= 150000000 and close[1] >= 50 and (close > highest(close, 250)[1] and volume >= 1.5 * sma(volume, 20))

strategies.name: GeminiNeon-Coiled Spring
strategies.description: NR7 in an uptrend: yesterday's range was the smallest of 7 days; today closes above yesterday's high
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 20)[1] >= 150000000 and close[1] >= 50 and ((high[1] - low[1]) < lowest(high - low, 6)[2] and close[1] > ema(close, 50)[1] and ema(close, 50)[1] > ema(close, 50)[6] and close > high[1])
strategies.notes: 'buy when price crosses yesterday's high' is taken on a daily close above it (entry next open)

strategies.name: GeminiNeon-Institutional Fair Price
strategies.description: VWAP reclaim: stock up on the day, the candle dips to or below VWAP and closes a strong green candle back above it
strategies.entry: avg_day_volume(20) * prev_day_close() >= 150000000 and prev_day_close() >= 50 and (close > prev_day_close() and low <= vwap and close > vwap and close > open and (close - open) >= 0.6 * (high - low))

strategies.name: GeminiNeon-Quiet Pullback
strategies.description: Volume dry-up: a strong up day (> 3% on > 2x volume) in the last 10 days, then 2 red low-volume days (< half average), then a green day breaking the previous high
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 20)[1] >= 150000000 and close[1] >= 50 and (any_of(close > 1.03 * close[1] and volume > 2 * sma(volume, 20), 10)[3] and close[1] < open[1] and close[2] < open[2] and volume[1] < 0.5 * sma(volume, 20)[1] and volume[2] < 0.5 * sma(volume, 20)[2] and close > open and close > high[1])

strategies.name: GeminiNeon-Overnight Surprise
strategies.description: Gap-and-go: day opens >= 2% above yesterday's high, holds above the first 15m low and breaks above the first 15m high
strategies.entry: avg_day_volume(20) * prev_day_close() >= 150000000 and prev_day_close() >= 50 and (session_open >= 1.02 * prev_day_high() and low > or_low(15) and cross_above(close, or_high(15)))
